title: Bungalow 8 | Royal Destinations
meta_description: WaterSound Home With Complimentary LSV (Low Speed Vehicle) Near Beach And Large Community Pools- Bungalow 8 by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Bungalow 8 by Royal Destinations Location: WaterSound Beach Proper Address: 8 North Watch Tower Lane, Inlet Beach, FL 32461 Details: This Martha’s Vineyard style coastal home is absolutely charming. Located near the beach on sought after South Watch Tower Lane, Bungalow 8 is filled with all the right finishes to enjoy your escape to the coast. While staying in this sophisticated and stylish community, guests will have access to 4 complimentary adult bikes and complimentary LSV (Low Speed Vehicle) to make transportation to the beach a breeze! The exterior shakes and indoor shiplap beam style is reminiscent of the Hamptons, offering a chef’s kitchen and open living concept. This is a destination you will return to for memories of a lifetime. The professionally designed 4-bedroom, 5-bathroom home accommodates 10 guests comfortably. The all en-suite guest rooms provide a retreat for everyone in your party. Situated between beach access and the beautiful DuneSider Pool, guests of Bungalow 8 can enjoy the poolside eatery and the convenience of the WaterSound sundries shop. Located on a large corner lot with ample parking, this home backs up to the boardwalk taking you directly to the white sand beaches of the Emerald Coast. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front Community Two Blocks from Beach (Home Adjacent to Beach Boardwalk) - Parking Spaces: 3 - Dining Accommodations: 6 at Dining Table - 3 at Island – 6 Outdoor Screened Dining - Complimentary LSV (Low Speed Vehicle) (WaterSound Use Only) WaterSound Community Highlights -Over 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach -(2) Community Pools (Dunesider Pool in Main Gate and Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate) -Kayak Rentals -Parks, Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks -Fitness Center (Fees Applicable) -Bike to Alys, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach -A short walk to The Big Chill (formerly The Hub) *Please Note: Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 4 Bedrooms / 5 Full Baths First Floor: - Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Separate Shower and Tub - Chef’s Kitchen, Open Living and Dining Concept, Wrap Around Porch with Dining, Full Bath - Adjacent to Beach Boardwalk -Laundry room Second Floor: - Guest Bedroom 2: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom 4: Two Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower and Separate Tub Amenities Include: - 4 Adult Bikes - Beach Towel Service Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
